name: Cardora
description:
About This Game

Cardora is a multiplayer party card game that combines Okey style gameplay with Poker hands, enhanced by unique card abilities.

With passive ability cards, you can enhance your combinations, while active ability cards let you interact with other players in real time disrupting their plans or strengthening your own strategy.

Cardora features a dynamic event system that reshapes the rules of each match. At the start of every cycle, a new global event is drawn, introducing special rules or modifiers that affect all players throughout that cycle. Once the cycle ends, the active event is discarded and replaced with a completely new one, ensuring that no two matches ever feel the same and forcing players to constantly adapt their strategies.

In future updates, Cardora will expand with additional single player and multiplayer game modes, offering players a wide range of new experiences.

Cardora is set in a dark medieval world, drawing inspiration from the era of the Black Plague through its gameplay mechanics and distinctive art style. Each game mode explores the Black Plague and other historical themes in its own unique way.

Cardora will feature multiple game modes, each offering a distinct way to experience its mechanics and dark medieval themes:

  • Plague Defense (Single Player)

    Defend your city against plague carrying creatures using card based mechanics and strategic defense elements. Survive escalating threats and protect your people from collapse.

Additional modes will be revealed in future updates.

  • Multiplayer party card gameplay blending Poker hands with Okey style mechanics

  • Active, passive ability cards and event system that create dynamic and unpredictable matches

  • High player interaction, including disruption, sabotage, and tactical advantages

  • Multiple game modes, including single player, team based, and free for all experiences

  • Dark medieval setting inspired by the era of the Black Plague

  • Strategic combo building with constantly shifting outcomes

  • Designed for replayability, with evolving strategies every match
short_desc: A multiplayer card game that fuses Poker and Okey mechanics with powerful active and passive cards. Build clever combinations, disrupt your opponents with interaction cards, and outplay everyone at the table.
